cause_in_this_apparatus: The v2 budget kept v1's 256 MiB swap-growth limit while moving the two free-memory thresholds for today's memory state. The swap limit was not re-derived. Loading about 7 GiB of model weights and context against 5.6 GiB of truly free memory made macOS page out about 2.9 GiB within ten seconds, most plausibly other applications' memory, which that limit cannot tolerate. The supervisor did what the budget told it to; the budget was wrong for this memory state. This is an error in this run's apparatus.
